say:1:1123640001:1.text: Recently, many of the young men in our clan have fallen in love with girls from other clans.
say:1:1123640001:1.source_cn: 最近，有不少黑嚎的年轻人爱上了外族姑娘。

say:2:1123640002:1.text: While I welcome such interactions, several issues come to my attention.
say:2:1123640002:1.source_cn: 我很欢迎这种交流，但也发现了不少问题。

say:3:1123640003:1.text: For instance, some clans have unique <style="highlight">marriage tests</style> in place. However, many young Grimmaw warriors are only skilled in battle and lack experience in this aspect.
say:3:1123640003:1.source_cn: 比如，外族有一些独特的<style=highlight...

say:4:1123640004:1.text: I hope you can give them some guidance.
say:4:1123640004:1.source_cn: 如果方便的话，希望你能指点他们一下。
say:4:1123640004:1.male: I hope you can give them some guidance.
say:4:1123640004:1.female: I hope you can give them some guidance.
